accepted_lessons.name: model_call_shape_contract_matches_registered_schedule
accepted_lessons.requirement: Enumerate every executed model-forward call site and prove before enqueue that its explicit validation mode accepts every registered logical batch size and padded sequence length; preserve separate checkpoint and model-structure validation.

builder_prompt_addendum: List every scientific model-forward call site. For each, bind the explicit interface-validation mode to the preregistered logical batch and padding schedule. Add a planted batch-32/variable-length versus fixed-(4,256) mismatch that preflight rejects without loading the model.
critic_prompt_addendum: Search for forward paths omitted by the builder's call-site census, implicit default validation flags, and dry runs that check row arithmetic without exercising the model-call shape contract. Require the fixed-(4,256) negative fixture to fail before enqueue.
